key_insight: AI is emerging as a practical framework to understand, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic perovskites (CsPbX3) by linking degradation mechanisms, reliability outcomes, and engineering design.
engineering_relevance: For perovskite solar cells and related optoelectronic devices, AI can accelerate stability screening and guide more robust materials, interfaces, and processing strategies under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
method: Consequence/reliability modeling and engineering stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The review highlights that existing studies rely on multimodal and often sparse data, with protocol-dependent results and limited uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-assisted analysis.
watch_item: Model transferability remains a concern because data quality, benchmark consistency, and interpretability vary widely across studies and degradation protocols.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
